incompatible_mil_attempts.scope: The tested generic dynamic-weight MIL form only.
Compilation failed before reload behavior could be tested; this does not falsify reload for a compatible MIL form.

dynamic_training_path.source_subtree: maderix/ANE training/training_dynamic at the bound source commit
dynamic_training_path.transport: FP16 compute weights are ordinary IOSurface activation regions consumed by dynamic matmul operators.
dynamic_training_path.compile_variance_interpretation: The full topology compiles on this M1, but fresh-process compiler latency is highly variable and must be amortized and measured at segment boundaries.

shape_sensitivity.interpretation: ANE compiler success is topology- and shape-specific; the tiny failure cannot falsify the production-shaped dynamic transport.

decoder_control.semantic_scope: Twelve-layer decoder-only control with a 4,096-token research vocabulary; excludes the source encoder, cross-attention, pointer generator, adapters, and Theseus objective.

gqa_grouping_probe.upstream_fault: Repeating the full two-KV-head tensor yields alternating KV-head ownership, while grouped-query attention requires four contiguous query heads per KV head. Upstream backward already assumes the grouped order.
gqa_grouping_probe.claim_boundary: This proves only head expansion. Complete attention forward/loss/gradient parity remains open.

split_half_rope_probe.claim_boundary: This proves production-shape split-half RoPE output only. Attention and backward parity remain open.

semantic_mismatches_found.rope: Upstream uses adjacent-pair interleaved rotation; Theseus uses split-half MLX RoPE with traditional=false.
semantic_mismatches_found.residual: Upstream scales attention and FFN residual branches by 1/sqrt(2*layers); Theseus adds both branches without scaling.
semantic_mismatches_found.vocabulary_loss: Upstream removes every vocabulary item absent from the local token file before softmax; Theseus loss normalizes over the full model vocabulary.
semantic_mismatches_found.objective: Upstream scores every next-token position; Theseus uses explicit loss masks plus pointer-copy and enabled auxiliary objective mass.
semantic_mismatches_found.model: Upstream is decoder-only; Theseus has a two-layer source encoder, per-decoder-layer cross-attention, tied full-vocabulary output, and pointer generator.
semantic_mismatches_found.batch: Upstream is batch one; the selected MLX route is sampler-exact batch 16 with compiled microbatch four.
semantic_mismatches_found.optimizer: Upstream owns a separate CPU Adam state; Theseus requires one authoritative FP32 AdamW state and one joined update.

process_coexistence.claim_scope: The MLX route is the full 54.8M encoder-decoder-pointer system while the ANE route is a 38.3M decoder-only FP16 research control. The combined rate is an unmatched mechanics ceiling, not an end-to-end speedup.

preferred_next_topology.primary: Critical-path projection triad: ANE forward/input-gradient, single-thread Accelerate FP32 weight-gradient, and MLX/Metal attention, output/loss, pointer, reduction, and optimizer work under one weight generation and one AdamW update.
preferred_next_topology.secondary: Synchronous heterogeneous data parallel over disjoint sampler-exact microbatches, one weight generation, one FP32 gradient accumulator, and one AdamW update.
preferred_next_topology.reason: The new public state path removes private compilation from the weight-transport question and CPU Accelerate makes dW a credible third-engine station. Both topologies preserve long independent work windows and avoid the measured losing wide physical join.

public_coreml_state_weight_transport.claim_scope: Public Core ML state-backed production-shape FP16 projection and nonidentity state publication only; no backward, optimizer, transformer, checkpoint, convergence, utility, or capability claim.

mlx_projection_control.claim_scope: Compiled MLX projection operator control only.

cpu_accelerate_dw.claim_scope: Standalone Accelerate FP32 weight-gradient operator mechanics only; no joined training or speedup claim.

three_engine_coexistence.claim_scope: Three-process CPU Accelerate, MLX/Metal, and Core ML/ANE mechanics only. The workloads are shape-related but are not one matched Theseus optimizer step, so their rates cannot be summed into a training claim.

exact_projection_triad.claim_scope: One deterministic q_proj-shaped optimizer transaction. It is not full attention, the complete Theseus objective, convergence, utility, or capability evidence. The losing public bridge narrows the immediate implementation to the proven private IOSurface transport.

native_zero_copy_projection_triad.next_gate: Retain MLX for direct q_proj. Measure one exact retained decoder activation and its backward dependency window, then test generation-tagged ANE recomputation concurrent with independent Metal backward work. Whole-microbatch and matched-arm concurrency remain later long-window candidates.
native_zero_copy_projection_triad.claim_scope: The exact native direct q_proj offload passes numerical, optimizer, replay, custody, and resource mechanics but loses joined wall to MLX. This is a narrow engineering exclusion for direct q_proj offload at this shape, not an architecture falsification of ANE recomputation, data parallelism, campaign concurrency, or inference.

weight_update_path.next_gate: Both the public and native zero-copy direct q_proj triads are dispositioned. The native route removes Python/NumPy and host copies and passes full station/optimizer parity, replay, save/reload, custody, resource, and zero-swap gates, but averages 4.344-4.459 ms versus 3.582-3.624 ms for MLX. Retain MLX for direct q_proj and move to ANE activation recomputation over an independently ready Metal backward window.

process_coexistence.gpu_workload: production-shaped compiled MLX QKV output/loss/gradient station
process_coexistence.ane_workload: width-512 baked-weight one-step ANE training control
process_coexistence.claim_scope: Independent-process useful-work coexistence only; no shared-tensor, zero-copy, split-linear, replay, or end-to-end training gain.

same_surface_bridge.claim_scope: The ANE consumed the Metal-written generation before any host read, then Metal and ANE concurrently read that immutable generation into distinct outputs. Partitioned linear parity, no-copy join, and MLX lazy integration remain open.

split_linear_station.next_candidate: Structure-aligned persistent partitions through attention or MLP with fused hidden-width reduction.

interpretation: The public Metal-to-IOSurface half is exact, same-generation concurrent reads are bit-exact, and both private activation-packed weights and public Core ML MLState prove mutable production-shape ANE weight transport without per-update model recompilation. The public q_proj triad passes numerical mechanics but its Python/NumPy/Core ML bridge averages 10.068 ms versus 4.941 ms for matched MLX. The native successor removes those bridges: Metal packs generation-tagged surfaces and owns loss/reductions/clip/AdamW, ANE computes forward/dX, and single-thread Accelerate consumes shared FP32 X/dY for dW. Across two alternating 64-update rounds it passes every registered full-array station and final-optimizer tolerance, exact replay/save-reload, finite-state, custody, resource, and zero-swap checks. It still averages 4.344-4.459 ms versus 3.582-3.624 ms for MLX, so direct q_proj offload is excluded at this shape. Retain MLX and move the ANE docket to activation recomputation with a real independent Metal backward window; do not generalize this engineering result to other ANE topologies. No end-to-end speed claim is allowed yet.
